links.title: Visa for Italy - Rights and duties of foreign nationals
Residence permit for family reunification | Polizia di Stato
Residence permit | Polizia di Stato

docs.text: Family reunification application filed online with the Sportello Unico per l'Immigrazione at the Prefettura
Eligible family members: spouse not legally separated and over 18; minor children; dependent adult children; dependent parents
Sponsor must hold an EC long-term residence permit or a residence permit for work, asylum, study, religion or family
Visa application form
Recent passport-size photo
Valid travel document
Residence permit application form (apply within 8 days of first entry)

links.title: Visa for Italy - Rights and duties of foreign nationals
Employment of foreign nationals | Polizia di Stato
Self-employed foreign nationals | Polizia di Stato

docs.text: Employer's application to the Sportello Unico per l'Immigrazione with full details of the worker
Photocopy of the worker's passport or equivalent travel document
Copy of the employment contract signed by employer and employee
Employer's statement undertaking to pay the worker's return trip in case of repatriation
Work visa issued by the Italian consulate in the country of origin or residence
Self-employment: evidence of sufficient funds to start the activity
Self-employment: certificate of enrolment in professional or trade registers, if required
Self-employment: evidence of appropriate accommodation and of annual income above the minimum required by law
Residence permit application within 8 days of arrival

docs.text: Visa application form
